description: This file defines the EventFactory class responsible for creating and managing event handler instances within the OFBiz web application framework. It loads event handlers based on configuration, initializes them, and provides access to retrieve handlers by type.

classes.name: EventFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing event handler instances based on configuration.

methods.name: EventFactory
methods.description: Constructor that loads and initializes event handlers from a configuration URL.

methods.name: getEventHandler
methods.description: Retrieves an event handler by its type, throws exception if not found.
